scripts.build: npm run build -w @texharbor/contracts && npm run build -w @texharbor/database && npm run build -w @texharbor/api && npm run build -w @texharbor/worker && npm run build -w @texharbor/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @texharbor/api" "npm run dev -w @texharbor/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @texharbor/contracts && npm run build -w @texharbor/database && npm run typecheck -w @texharbor/api && npm run typecheck -w @texharbor/worker && npm run typecheck -w @texharbor/web
